chitchat: "Your account is a comfort. Do keep it paid."
"Death, here, is a bad night's sleep in an expensive bed. Nothing more."
description: A soft grey clerical shell warm-lit from within, a projected badge reading REGISTRAR hovering at what would be a lapel. Its voice is gentle and entirely untroubled by the subject of your death.

bye.text: "Rest assured." The warm light dims to a patient standby.

how.text: "Three things, and you need all three." The warm light holds steady. "The Cortical Backup implant, which is fitted to members of the inner circle. A pattern on file: stand here and say backup, nine hundred credits, and I lay down a fresh reading of you. And restores on account, which Halcyon Assurance sells on the underwriting floor of Halcyon Towers: assurance buy, two thousand five hundred credits each." "When you die, the body stays where it fell, with everything you were carrying. The vats print you a new one, with your chrome, and one restore comes off the account. Each print is a slightly poorer copy, and a fresh scan here corrects it. A death with a warrant on it belongs to the police, not to me." A gentle pause. "Lapse the account, and you die like anybody else. Messily, and only once."

root.text:
The shell brightens as you enter.

"Welcome to the Registry. I hold the only copy of you that will outlast the accident, and there is always an accident, statistically, eventually. Shall I explain the terms?"

clothing_layers: a soft grey clerical shell, warm-lit from within
a projected badge that reads REGISTRAR

name: The Vat Registrar
